verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَقُلْ لَهُمْ: مَوَاسِمُ ٱلرَّبِّ ٱلَّتِي فِيهَا تُنَادُونَ مَحَافِلَ مُقَدَّسَةً. هَذِهِ هِيَ مَوَاسِمِي:
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, [Concerning] the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim [to be] holy convocations, [even] these [are] my feasts.
verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

verses.ar: سِتَّةَ أَيَّامٍ يُعْمَلُ عَمَلٌ، وَأَمَّا ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلسَّابِعُ فَفِيهِ سَبْتُ عُطْلَةٍ مَحْفَلٌ مُقَدَّسٌ. عَمَلًا مَّا لَا تَعْمَلُوا. إِنَّهُ سَبْتٌ لِلرَّبِّ فِي جَمِيعِ مَسَاكِنِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day [is] the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work [therein:] it [is] the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.
verses.web: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to Yahweh in all your dwellings.

verses.ar: «هَذِهِ مَوَاسِمُ ٱلرَّبِّ، ٱلْمَحَافِلُ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةُ ٱلَّتِي تُنَادُونَ بِهَا فِي أَوْقَاتِهَا:
verses.kjv: ¶ These [are] the feasts of the LORD, [even] holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.
verses.web: “‘These are the set feasts of Yahweh, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

verses.ar: فِي ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ، فِي ٱلرَّابِعَ عَشَرَ مِنَ ٱلشَّهْرِ، بَيْنَ ٱلْعِشَاءَيْنِ فِصْحٌ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: In the fourteenth [day] of the first month at even [is] the LORD’s passover.
verses.web: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is Yahweh’s Passover.

verses.ar: وَفِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْخَامِسَ عَشَرَ مِنْ هَذَا ٱلشَّهْرِ عِيدُ ٱلْفَطِيرِ لِلرَّبِّ. سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ تَأْكُلُونَ فَطِيرًا.
verses.kjv: And on the fifteenth day of the same month [is] the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.
verses.web: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to Yahweh. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

verses.ar: فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ يَكُونُ لَكُمْ مَحْفَلٌ مُقَدَّسٌ. عَمَلًا مَّا مِنَ ٱلشُّغْلِ لَا تَعْمَلُوا.
verses.kjv: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.web: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

verses.ar: وَسَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ تُقَرِّبُونَ وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ. فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلسَّابِعِ يَكُونُ مَحْفَلٌ مُقَدَّسٌ. عَمَلًا مَّا مِنَ ٱلشُّغْلِ لَا تَعْمَلُوا».
verses.kjv: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day [is] an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work [therein].
verses.web: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”

verses.ar: وكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَقُلْ لَهُمْ: مَتَى جِئْتُمْ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا أُعْطِيكُمْ وَحَصَدْتُمْ حَصِيدَهَا، تَأْتُونَ بِحُزْمَةِ أَوَّلِ حَصِيدِكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْكَاهِنِ.
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.

verses.ar: فَيُرَدِّدُ ٱلْحُزْمَةَ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ لِلرِّضَا عَنْكُمْ. فِي غَدِ ٱلسَّبْتِ يُرَدِّدُهَا ٱلْكَاهِنُ.
verses.kjv: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.web: He shall wave the sheaf before Yahweh, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

verses.ar: وَتَعْمَلُونَ يَوْمَ تَرْدِيدِكُمُ ٱلْحُزْمَةَ خَرُوفًا صَحِيحًا حَوْلِيًّا مُحْرَقَةً لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
verses.web: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

verses.ar: وَتَقْدِمَتَهُ عُشْرَيْنِ مِنْ دَقِيقٍ مَلْتُوتٍ بِزَيْتٍ، وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ رَائِحَةَ سَرُورٍ، وَسَكِيبَهُ رُبْعَ ٱلْهِينِ مِنْ خَمْرٍ.
verses.kjv: And the meat offering thereof [shall be] two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD [for] a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof [shall be] of wine, the fourth [part] of an hin.
verses.web: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

verses.ar: وَخُبْزًا وَفَرِيكًا وَسَوِيقًا لَا تَأْكُلُوا إِلَى هَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ عَيْنِهِ، إِلَى أَنْ تَأْتُوا بِقُرْبَانِ إِلَهِكُمْ، فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ فِي جَمِيعِ مَسَاكِنِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: [it shall be] a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.web: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.ar: «ثُمَّ تَحْسُبُونَ لَكُمْ مِنْ غَدِ ٱلسَّبْتِ مِنْ يَوْمِ إِتْيَانِكُمْ بِحُزْمَةِ ٱلتَّرْدِيدِ سَبْعَةَ أَسَابِيعَ تَكُونُ كَامِلَةً.
verses.kjv: ¶ And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
verses.web: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.

verses.ar: إِلَى غَدِ ٱلسَّبْتِ ٱلسَّابِعِ تَحْسُبُونَ خَمْسِينَ يَوْمًا، ثُمَّ تُقَرِّبُونَ تَقْدِمَةً جَدِيدَةً لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.
verses.web: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to Yahweh.

verses.ar: مِنْ مَسَاكِنِكُمْ تَأْتُونَ بِخُبْزِ تَرْدِيدٍ، رَغِيفَيْنِ عُشْرَيْنِ يَكُونَانِ مِنْ دَقِيقٍ، وَيُخْبَزَانِ خَمِيرًا بَاكُورَةً لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; [they are] the firstfruits unto the LORD.
verses.web: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to Yahweh.

verses.ar: وَتُقَرِّبُونَ مَعَ ٱلْخُبْزِ سَبْعَةَ خِرَافٍ صَحِيحَةٍ حَوْلِيَّةٍ، وَثَوْرًا وَاحِدًا ٱبْنَ بَقَرٍ، وَكَبْشَيْنِ مُحْرَقَةً لِلرَّبِّ مَعَ تَقْدِمَتِهَا وَسَكِيبِهَا وَقُودَ رَائِحَةِ سَرُورٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be [for] a burnt offering unto the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, [even] an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.web: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to Yahweh, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to Yahweh.

verses.ar: وَتَعْمَلُونَ تَيْسًا وَاحِدًا مِنَ ٱلْمَعْزِ ذَبِيحَةَ خَطِيَّةٍ، وَخَرُوفَيْنِ حَوْلِيَّيْنِ ذَبِيحَةَ سَلَامَةٍ.
verses.kjv: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
verses.web: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

verses.ar: فَيُرَدِّدُهَا ٱلْكَاهِنُ مَعَ خُبْزِ ٱلْبَاكُورَةِ تَرْدِيدًا أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ مَعَ ٱلْخَرُوفَيْنِ، فَتَكُونُ لِلْكَاهِنِ قُدْسًا لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits [for] a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
verses.web: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before Yahweh, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to Yahweh for the priest.

verses.ar: وَتُنَادُونَ فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ عَيْنِهِ مَحْفَلًا مُقَدَّسًا يَكُونُ لَكُمْ. عَمَلًا مَّا مِنَ ٱلشُّغْلِ لَا تَعْمَلُوا. فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً فِي جَمِيعِ مَسَاكِنِكُمْ فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, [that] it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work [therein: it shall be] a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
verses.web: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

verses.ar: وَعِنْدَمَا تَحْصُدُونَ حَصِيدَ أَرْضِكُمْ، لَا تُكَمِّلْ زَوَايَا حَقْلِكَ فِي حَصَادِكَ، وَلُقَاطَ حَصِيدِكَ لَا تَلْتَقِطْ. لِلْمِسْكِينِ وَٱلْغَرِيبِ تَتْرُكُهُ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمْ».
verses.kjv: ¶ And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.web: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.’”

verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ قَائِلًا: فِي ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلسَّابِعِ، فِي أَوَّلِ ٱلشَّهْرِ يَكُونُ لَكُمْ عُطْلَةٌ، تَذْكَارُ هُتَافِ ٱلْبُوقِ، مَحْفَلٌ مُقَدَّسٌ.
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first [day] of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

verses.ar: عَمَلًا مَّا مِنَ ٱلشُّغْلِ لَا تَعْمَلُوا، لَكِنْ تُقَرِّبُونَ وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ».
verses.kjv: Ye shall do no servile work [therein:] but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.web: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.’”

verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.ar: «أَمَّا ٱلْعَاشِرُ مِنْ هَذَا ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلسَّابِعِ، فَهُوَ يَوْمُ ٱلْكَفَّارَةِ. مَحْفَلًا مُقَدَّسًا يَكُونُ لَكُمْ. تُذَلِّلُونَ نُفُوسَكُمْ وَتُقَرِّبُونَ وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Also on the tenth [day] of this seventh month [there shall be] a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.web: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

verses.ar: عَمَلًا مَّا لَا تَعْمَلُوا فِي هَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ عَيْنِهِ، لِأَنَّهُ يَوْمُ كَفَّارَةٍ لِلتَّكْفِيرِ عَنْكُمْ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it [is] a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.
verses.web: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Yahweh your God.

verses.ar: إِنَّ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ لَا تَتَذَلَّلُ فِي هَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ عَيْنِهِ تُقْطَعُ مِنْ شَعْبِهَا.
verses.kjv: For whatsoever soul [it be] that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.web: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.

verses.ar: وَكُلَّ نَفْسٍ تَعْمَلُ عَمَلًا مَّا فِي هَذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ عَيْنِهِ أُبِيدُ تِلْكَ ٱلنَّفْسَ مِنْ شَعْبِهَا.
verses.kjv: And whatsoever soul [it be] that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
verses.web: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.

verses.ar: عَمَلًا مَّا لَا تَعْمَلُوا. فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ فِي جَمِيعِ مَسَاكِنِكُمْ.
verses.kjv: Ye shall do no manner of work: [it shall be] a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.web: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُ سَبْتُ عُطْلَةٍ لَكُمْ، فَتُذَلِّلُونَ نُفُوسَكُمْ. فِي تَاسِعِ ٱلشَّهْرِ عِنْدَ ٱلْمَسَاءِ. مِنَ ٱلْمَسَاءِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاءِ تَسْبِتُونَ سَبْتَكُمْ».
verses.kjv: It [shall be] unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth [day] of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
verses.web: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ قَائِلًا: فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْخَامِسَ عَشَرَ مِنْ هَذَا ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلسَّابِعِ عِيدُ ٱلْمَظَالِّ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month [shall be] the feast of tabernacles [for] seven days unto the LORD.
verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to Yahweh.

verses.ar: فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ مَحْفَلٌ مُقَدَّسٌ. عَمَلًا مَّا مِنَ ٱلشُّغْلِ لَا تَعْمَلُوا.
verses.kjv: On the first day [shall be] an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work [therein].
verses.web: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

verses.ar: سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ تُقَرِّبُونَ وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ. فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلثَّامِنِ يَكُونُ لَكُمْ مَحْفَلٌ مُقَدَّسٌ تُقَرِّبُونَ وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ. إِنَّهُ ٱعْتِكَافٌ. كُلُّ عَمَلِ شُغْلٍ لَا تَعْمَلُوا.
verses.kjv: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it [is] a solemn assembly; [and] ye shall do no servile work [therein].
verses.web: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.

verses.ar: «هَذِهِ هِيَ مَوَاسِمُ ٱلرَّبِّ ٱلَّتِي فِيهَا تُنَادُونَ مَحَافِلَ مُقَدَّسَةً لِتَقْرِيبِ وَقُودٍ لِلرَّبِّ، مُحْرَقَةً وَتَقْدِمَةً وَذَبِيحَةً وَسَكِيبًا أَمْرَ ٱلْيَوْمِ بِيَوْمِهِ،
verses.kjv: These [are] the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim [to be] holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:
verses.web: “‘These are the appointed feasts of Yahweh which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—

verses.ar: عَدَا سُبُوتِ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَعَدَا عَطَايَاكُمْ وَجَمِيعِ نُذُورِكُمْ، وَجَمِيعِ نَوَافِلِكُمُ ٱلَّتِي تُعْطُونَهَا لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.
verses.web: in addition to the Sabbaths of Yahweh, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to Yahweh.

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْخَامِسَ عَشَرَ مِنَ ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلسَّابِعِ فَفِيهِ، عِنْدَمَا تَجْمَعُونَ غَلَّةَ ٱلْأَرْضِ، تُعَيِّدُونَ عِيدًا لِلرَّبِّ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ. فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ عُطْلَةٌ وَفِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلثَّامِنِ عُطْلَةٌ.
verses.kjv: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day [shall be] a sabbath, and on the eighth day [shall be] a sabbath.
verses.web: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of Yahweh seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

verses.ar: وَتَأْخُذُونَ لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ثَمَرَ أَشْجَارٍ بَهِجَةٍ وَسَعَفَ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَأَغْصَانَ أَشْجَارٍ غَبْيَاءَ وَصَفْصَافَ ٱلْوَادِي، وَتَفْرَحُونَ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكُمْ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ.
verses.kjv: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
verses.web: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before Yahweh your God seven days.

verses.ar: تُعَيِّدُونَهُ عِيدًا لِلرَّبِّ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ فِي ٱلسَّنَةِ فَرِيضَةً دَهْرِيَّةً فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ. فِي ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلسَّابِعِ تُعَيِّدُونَهُ.
verses.kjv: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year. [It shall be] a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.web: You shall keep it as a feast to Yahweh seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.

verses.ar: فِي مَظَالَّ تَسْكُنُونَ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ. كُلُّ ٱلْوَطَنِيِّينَ فِي إِسْرَائِيلَ يَسْكُنُونَ فِي ٱلْمَظَالِّ.
verses.kjv: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
verses.web: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,

verses.ar: لِكَيْ تَعْلَمَ أَجْيَالُكُمْ أَنِّي فِي مَظَالَّ أَسْكَنْتُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ لَمَّا أَخْرَجْتُهُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِ مِصْرَ. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمْ».
verses.kjv: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.web: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.’”

verses.ar: فَأَخْبَرَ مُوسَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ بِمَوَاسِمِ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.
verses.web: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of Yahweh.
